name: POST /api/leadflow/channels/sms/sent - Log an SMS that actually went out
description: Records that a text was dispatched for one subject, so the volume ledger the SMS gate reads is built from sends that HAPPENED rather than sends that were intended. 201 because it inserts a log row at a collection root. `automated` defaults to true and is the field that matters: an automated send counts against pacing and consent rules while a rep typing a message by hand does not, and defaulting the other way would let automation hide inside manual traffic. template_key is optional, because an improvised message is exactly the thing worth recording as having had no template. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token.

testCases.name: An automated send is logged against its template
NEGATIVE: a send with nobody to attribute it to
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
subject_ref is absent or blank. A logged send with no subject cannot be counted against anybody's pacing or consent, which is the only reason the ledger exists.
